description: Rede de abastecimento de água is a series of datasets listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Esse arquivo se refere ao cadastro de atualização contínua da Embasa, das redes de água do município de Santo Antônio de Jesus, em escala 1:2000. Coverage: Brasil. The portal lists 12 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its tags are Bahia, imageryBaseMapsEarthCover. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
